top_signals.title: Wheat Erases Black Sea Premium as Russia Signals Shipping Talks
top_signals.summary: Wheat futures erased the Black Sea risk premium that had built since Russia and Ukraine escalated attacks in early July, after a report that Moscow is considering proposals to secure grain shipments through the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The new India-Pakistan ‘cold war’
top_signals.summary: India will return to the negotiating table only after Pakistan dismantles, comprehensively and verifiably, its state-supported terrorist networks.

top_signals.title: Lula Upset Jolts Brazil Assets, Emerging Stocks Sink to July Low
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s surprise election result dominated emerging-market trading Monday as the country’s stocks, currencies and debt plunged following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva victory.

top_signals.title: Gasoline Prices Under Trump Surpass Biden-Era Average
top_signals.summary: The average price Americans are paying for gasoline under President Donald Trump has overtaken the average during the Biden administration, underscoring the political pressure on Republicans ahead of the midterm elections.

top_signals.title: Borr Drilling Rig Sinks Off Gabon, 110 Rescued as Search for Five Missing Continues
top_signals.summary: Borr Drilling's Prospector 5 jack-up rig has sunk offshore Gabon after experiencing a punch-through event during preload operations that caused it to lose stability, leaving five people missing and 110 safely accounted for among the 115 personnel on board.In its latest update on October 26…
